cases.case_label: L1HS in DMD intron 1 with partial L1 exonization (Becker MD)
cases.mechanism_detail: A ~6-kb insertion of an L1HS-annotated sequence (identical to a copy in KCNB2 intron 2) flanked by a 17-bp duplication in deep DMD intron 1 activates a cryptic donor in the L1 and a cryptic acceptor in intron 1, inserting a 111-bp pseudoexon (15 bp intron 1 + G + 95 bp L1) between exons 1 and 2 alongside normal transcript; dystrophin was reduced in muscle.
cases.quote: (I) The cryptic 5′ ss and 3′ ss activation resulted in the 111-bp sequence insertion between DMD exons 1 and 2, consisting of a 15-bp sequence of DMD intron 1, a single guanine nucleotide, and the partial exonization of LINE-1 (95 bp).
